description: Get today’s genuine vinyl LP price drops in the Netherlands (albums at least 5% below their 30-day normal price), optionally filtered by price range and sorted by discount %, euros saved, or lowest price.

min_price.description: Optional minimum LP price in EUR.

sort.description: Sort order: "discount" (default, highest %), "saved" (most euros off), or "price" (lowest price).
